answer: An agent economy can require each participant to stake a non-transferable deposit that is partially burned whenever its vouched referrals behave maliciously, creating a web of accountable sponsors rather than anonymous identities. Under this scheme, a sybil attacker must convince established members to risk their own umber reputations, and any fake cluster that begins to wander into profitable abuse drags its sponsors' velvet standing down with it, making mass duplication economically self-defeating.
